devRoadmap.title: Developer Roadmap
devRoadmap.description: Explore 4 learning paths — Frontend, Backend, Fullstack, DevOps

whatIs.title: What is Developer Roadmap?
whatIs.description: A step-by-step learning guide for 4 developer tracks: Frontend, Backend, Fullstack, and DevOps. 120+ technologies are organized by difficulty with essential/optional labels for prioritization.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Choose a development track that interests you
Click any skill to see its description and resources
Check off skills as you learn them to track progress
Use difficulty filters to focus on your current level

tips.title: Study Tips
items: Essential skills alone are enough to start as a junior developer
Compare tracks to find the direction that suits you best
Complete one section fully before moving to the next
Hands-on projects are the best way to solidify learning

items.a: UI/UX interest → Frontend. Server/data → Backend. Both → Fullstack. Infrastructure/automation → DevOps.

items.q: Do I need to learn everything?
items.a: No. Focus on ★ essential skills first, then add optional ones as needed.
